entities.summary: Francisco de Borja Álvarez de Toledo y Gonzaga, 12th Marquis of Villafranca inherited the title of Marquis of Villafranca and Duke of Medina Sidonia from his elder brother José Álvarez de Toledo, Duke of Alba in 1796, as well as becoming the 14th Marquis of Cazaza, 10th Duke of Bivona and 12th Marquis of Los Vélez.
